component.name: Wheelguard
component.summary: Scroll bounce filter and advanced settings for your mouse

description.p: Wheelguard drops the bouncing, wrong-direction scroll-wheel ticks of a faulty encoder on GNOME, with a live view of the wheel. It also edits the on-board settings of the Endgame Gear XM2w 4k v2 (DPI, polling rate, lift-off distance, button filtering, sleep timers and battery) and the GNOME pointer settings. Not affiliated with Endgame Gear.
